verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in, first-party MCP server, so AI assistants such as Claude can browse issues, inspect stack traces, search logs, detect N+1 queries, and resolve or ignore issues. That lets users operate parts of the product in natural language through an external AI client. There is no native natural-language command interface inside GlitchTip, and the MCP tools cover mainly investigation and issue-state changes rather than full product administration. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language interface, natural-language control of setup/admin tasks (projects, teams, alerts, uptime monitors), independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: GlitchTip includes a built-in MCP server that allows AI assistants to interact with your error tracking, performance, and log data.
Investigate errors — Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
